title: Hydro Vanilla SMP
description: A community-driven Vanilla Minecraft server, running since 2018. No other place offers Vanilla Gameplay like we do! Apply on our Discord to join Hydro today!
body:
***WE HAVE JUST UPGRADED TO 26.1.2 SO YOU CAN PLAY WITH THE LATEST FEATURES!***

**Hydro SMP has been running since 2018; one of the longest-standing Minecraft communities out there. We're currently in a Long-Term Season (started July 11th, 2025) with no plans to reset, ever. Build what you want, come back whenever you like; your progress is safe.**

* Very active! We average a concurrent player-count of 15-35 at any time of the day so there is always someone to chat to! On the weekends this will peak at around 40-55 players!
* **ADULTS ONLY!** You have to be 18+ to join the server, so you can expect a mature environment on Hydro. No kids allowed here :)
* We have, and always will be, a completely vanilla server with some performance enhancing mods + moderator tools. **No griefing** on our server, ever! We always stay on the latest version for the best playing experience we can offer!
* Community driven: Our community of over **3000+ Discord Members** has been with us for a long time. Some members new, some have been around for years and years. All of the decisions regarding the server are decided and voted on by the entire community, everyone has a say!
* **Completely GRIEF FREE**: We use some moderation tools to be able to rollback and inspect player interactions, and we can assure no griefing will ever happen on our watch. We handle a VERY strict no-tolerance policy against griefing, cheating etc.

**What you should know:**  
Even though the server is completely Vanilla, we make use of a custom resource pack to add some custom models to the server like custom hats, signs and banners. No game changing items, these are just for looks and are mostly cosmetics! Some of the mods we use:

* [BlueMap](https://map.hydrovanillasmp.com/)
* **Proximity VoiceChat**
* **AudioPlayer**
* **VanillaTweak Datapacks (Dragon Drops elytra, more slabs; trapdoors; stairs)**
* **& more!**

Our server is hosted in The Netherlands, Europe and is ran on an **AMD Ryzen 9 9950X CPU** with **30GB of RAM** for the most high-performance Minecraft experience you've ever had! We guarantee 20 TPS all around and closely monitor our servers performance through Grafana!

If you feel like Hydro SMP is the server for you, don't hesitate to join and fill in an application on our Discord below!

[https://discord.gg/hydrosmp](https://discord.gg/hydrosmp)

Our live map of your current season!:

[https://map.hydrovanillasmp.com](https://map.hydrovanillasmp.com/)

Thank you and hope to see you on Hydro SMP soon! :)
